To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the aerial oxidation of a cobalt(II)-hydrazone complex in the presence of an oxidant leads to the formation of a dinuclear cobalt (III)-hydrazone compound through the C-C coupling of two ligand units.

The aerial oxidation of Co(II) salt containing a hydrazine ligand, (condensation product benzoyl acetophenone and benzhydrazone) leads to the formation of a dinuclear Co(III) complex, [Co(L)2(L').0.25H20] where L = hydrazone ligands and L' = C-C bonded ligand.
a novel dinuclear Co(III) hydrazeno complex has been synthesized, characterized and its crystal structure has been determined.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of a novel dinucle-ar Co(III) hydra-zone complex, [Co 2(L)2L'] 0.25H20.
the synthesis and characterization of a new dinuclear cobalt(III) hydra-zone complex.
the study of new ligands and their metal complexes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the aerial oxidation of the Co(II) salt containing the hydrazone ligands leads to the coupling between the two hydrazone liganding units and the oxidation of cobalt to Co(III) giving rise to the dinuclear complex, [Co(II)(L)2(L')(0.25H(2)O)](2+).
the aerial oxidation of the cobalt(II)-hydrazone system in the presence of the hydrazone ligands, leads to the formation of dinuclear cobalt(III) hydrazones through the coupling of two ligand units.
a novel dinuclear Co(III) complex compound, [Co2L2L'(].0.25 H2O, has been synthesized and its structure characterized by X-ray crystal diffraction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a new dinuclear complex, [Co(L)2(L')].0.25 H2O, has been synthesized and characterized by spectroscopic techniques and single crystal X-ray diffraction.
a new dinuclear cobalt(III) complex has been synthesized and characterized.

the aerial oxidation of Co(II) hydrazone complexes in methanolic solution leads to the formation of dinuclear complexes containing a C-C sigma-bonds between the two hydrazone ligands, and the oxidation state of the Co(III) ions is +3.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the C-C sigma-bonds can be formed between two different ligands, and this is an unusual feature.
the aerial oxidation of Co(II) in the presence of a hydrazone type ligand can lead to a C-C sigma-bonds formation between two such hydrazone ligands.
the hydrazone ligands, which are known to have a high tendency to undergo aerial oxidation, are able to undergo C-C coupling in the presence of Co(II) salt.
